ModMetaData.name: Gravship Compat (local patches)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Local content + compatibility patches for the "crashed Factory ship / Jawa stowaways" gravship campaign. Self-authored, kept minimal and defensive. Each PATCH is wrapped in PatchOperationConditional so a missing target (mod not loaded, def renamed in an update) is a silent no-op instead of a red error. LOAD THIS LAST in the mod order (RimSort), after every mod it touches.
Currently contains: - Defs/WeatherDefs/SWDesertWeather.xml — four hazard weathers (sandstorm, dry sandstorm, red fog, red foggy rain) extracted from "Star Wars - Biomes Addon" (Ferreira312, WS 2298926362). Pure XML, no assembly: the mod's custom C# overlay classes were swapped for the vanilla fog overlay while keeping all gameplay fields (accuracy/move/wind/lightning). Sandstorm cuts ranged accuracy to 0.25; dry sandstorm adds lightning-started fires; red fog / foggy rain reduce accuracy (and, for the rain, move speed). - Patches/SWDesertWeather_Attach.xml — injects those weathers into hot/arid biomes (sandstorms) and volcanic/exotic biomes (red fog) via baseWeatherCommonalities. Conditional-wrapped per biome. Tune the commonality numbers there to taste.
